chunks: And whenever ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام saw a funeral, he would say: “Praise be to Allah, who did not make me among the suddenly taken multitude.”

key_terms.السَّوَادِ: the mass or multitude of people
key_terms.الْحَمْدُ: praise and gratitude directed to Allah
key_terms.الْمُخْتَرَمِ: those cut off suddenly by death
key_terms.جَنَازَةً: a funeral bier or funeral procession

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام say when he saw a funeral?
ai.summary: This report preserves a supplication recited by Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام upon seeing a funeral. It expresses gratitude to Allah for continued life and serves as a reminder of death and the fleeting nature of worldly existence.
